observations: Prediction specifies count-then-letter coding and alternating eight-pixel row.
Alternating B/W encoded as sixteen characters; painting second pixel black merged a three-black run and reduced code to twelve characters.
All-white row shrank; changing to sixteen white pixels produced 16W, three characters.
Reveal retains best sixteen-to-three and worst eight-to-sixteen observed cases, explains per-run overhead and gives the counting argument that not every input can shrink.

complexity.conceptualDemand: Compare encoded character count with raw symbolic length.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Clickable pixels, size toggle and presets.

whyCool: Compression works by exploiting structure, so removing that structure can turn the same method into expansion.
caveat: Compares textual character counts with symbolic pixels, not a complete binary file format including headers.
effort: Prediction, alternating preset, manual pixel merge, all-white and sixteen-pixel boundary, screenshots and reveal.
bucketReason: Highly manipulable success/failure contrast with an explicit overhead mechanism.

prediction.reason: Precise specified-code comparison with direct plausible alternatives.
prediction.evidence: Shorter, same or longer for alternating row.

interaction.reason: Free pixel painting, size change and presets test both compression and expansion.
interaction.evidence: Alternating, merged run, all-white eight and sixteen.

payoff.reason: Explains actual best/worst cases, overhead and a broader impossibility principle.
payoff.evidence: Every singleton needs count plus letter; fewer short codes than inputs.

clarity.reason: Raw pixels, literal code and counts make encoding overhead visible.
clarity.evidence: Sixteen characters versus eight pixels; 16W has three characters.

transfer.reason: General applicability condition plus failed case.
transfer.evidence: Long runs help; alternating inputs grow; no universal shrinking code.

surprise.reason: A compression method can make data larger.

visualExplanation.reason: Painted runs and literal code directly map input structure to output cost.
visualExplanation.evidence: Merged black run changes several code pairs into 3B.

playfulness.reason: Free painting and size changes let learners construct cases.

depth.reason: Run overhead and global coding limit connect.
depth.evidence: Local compression success versus universal impossibility.
